question: Should maintainers proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102563 as the canonical implementation for the Cohere Command catalog and onboarding-default refresh?
rationale: The issue is protected by the `maintainer` label, changes a user-facing provider default, and is paired with a draft PR whose live Cohere proof is still pending.

options.title: Review linked PR after proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked draft PR as the canonical implementation path once Cohere live proof or an explicit proof waiver is available.

options.title: Accept catalog tests only
options.body: Maintainers may decide official docs plus focused catalog/onboarding tests are enough and allow the linked PR to proceed without live provider credentials.

options.title: Narrow the direction
options.body: Maintainers may keep old Command A as default or split Vision/live-sweep behavior into follow-up work if the default change is not desired.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked draft PR as the canonical implementation path once Cohere live proof or an explicit proof waiver is available.
